SUMMARY SHEET
Page 1 - Paragraph 3
Item number 2 would be in better perspective if it were re-worded to read: "elimination of approximately 2.3 miles (1.3 surface acres) of trout stream representing about 1.0 percent of the state's trout stream mileage, and 0.23 percent of its surface area (this does not include Lake Jocassee, a 7,565 acre reservoir constructed by Buke Power Company, which supports a trout fishery)".
The paragraph has been revised. Staff concludes that the sentence is adequate with this minor revision.
